messages:
jia: Quick heads-up — observed ~12% P95 regression on small-batch decode after the fused-paged-attn change. Root trace attached.

mike: can you paste the perf summary / flame?

jia: perf snapshot (decode, batch=1, seq=64, GPU A100):
```
wall: 1.35ms -> 1.51ms (+12%)
kernel-launch: 38% of time
memcpy(H2D/D2H): 28% (unexpected)
kv-lookup stalls: 10% wall
flash-paged-fused kernel: 0.6ms -> 0.72ms
fallback path (non-fused paged): 0.45ms
``` 
Notable: memcpy spikes only on decode path; prefill doesn't show this.

sam: interesting — memcpy suggests extra host-device sync or page walking. Is KV page miss causing a host-side fallback/serialization?

jia: hypothesis: the fused paged kernel added an extra fallback path that does synchronous page table fetches for small batches. Prefill path uses batched KV probes and benefits from async prefetching.

anna: can we reproduce in microbench? mike ran a small run and saw similar but smaller delta.

mike: repro steps I used:
```
python tools/bench_attention.py --model=gpt-neo --kernel=fused-paged --batch=1 --seq=64 --mode=decode --iters=100 --profile=flame
```
Also try `--kernel=flash` and `--kernel=paged-unfused`.

perf-bot: Scheduled perf job 2103456792 started (bench-suite: attention-small-decode). Link: https://perf.internal/jobs/2103456792

leo: quick note — kernel selection heuristic currently picks fused-paged for any model with paged enabled and seq<=128. Maybe that's too aggressive for batch=1.

sam: action items:
- run microbench toggling fused flag (sam)
- add memcopy histograms to decode profile (mike)
- temporarily revert fused-paged for small-batch decode and measure SLOs (anna)

jia: I can attach the full traces and nvprof output, uploading now.

mike: if this is real, safe fallback for small-batch decode is to prefer the non-fused variant unless throughput>X. We'll need a perf gate.

anna: I'll draft a kernel-selection change: prefer non-fused for batch<=2 or when KV hit rate < 90%. Will open PR and add a rollout flag. 

sam: I'll run the microbench and post results by EOD.

perf-bot: Job 2103456792 completed: regression detected P95 +11.9% (confidence: high). Details: https://perf.internal/jobs/2103456792/report

mike: thanks — let's keep this thread for triage. If someone's oncall and sees production alerts, ping #eng-oncall.

jia: thanks all. attaching nvprof snippets and commands under the thread.

anna: assigned to me: I'll open rollout PR with feature flag AND add canary monitors.

sam: uploaded microbench results: fused=1.51ms, unfused=1.18ms, flash=1.12ms. KV miss rate correlated with memcpy.

leo: putting tentative ship-blocker label until we confirm rollback isn't needed.

jia: noted. end of thread for now — will update when sam has numbers.
